qualification.details: Assistant Professor (Tenure Basis) - Economics: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in Economics/Econometrics from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC or the CSIR. Ph.D. Degree holders are exempted from NET as per the UGC Regulations 2018. Other eligibility conditions as per UGC Regulations 2018.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CUSAT to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Assistant Professor (Tenure Basis) - Economics : A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in Economics/Econometrics from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC or the CSIR. Ph.D. Degree holders are exempted from NET as per the UGC Regulations 2018. Other eligibility conditions as per UGC Regulations 2018.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CUSAT Assistant Professor (Tenure Basis) - Economics Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CUSAT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) for positions in Kochi, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Assistant Professor (Tenure Basis) - Economics under the Centre for Budget Studies.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Assistant Professor (Tenure Basis) - Economics position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in Economics/Econometrics along with NET/CSIR qualification or an earned Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered to selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected Ph.D. holders receive ₹ 47,000/- per month, while other contract teachers receive ₹ 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for general candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for general category candidates is ₹ 950/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC/ST category candidates is ₹ 195/-.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official portal and subsequently send a hard copy of the application with supporting documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application must be sent to The Registrar, Cochin University of Science & Technology, Kochi - 682 022.
